payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-26: the #GCB0DV timing probe has run (see #T9PRB9). It did not break out verification latency, so it does not yet answer whether verification latency matters. The owner decision to leave RAG_TELEMETRY_EXTENDED off stands; revisit when #T9PRB9's repeat runs report a verification split. PRIOR DETAIL: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-26 (Josh, 'all as recommended'): leave RAG_TELEMETRY_EXTENDED off. Revisit after the #GCB0DV timing probe shows whether verification latency matters. PRIOR DETAIL: PR #2056 persisted verification_latency_ms behind RAG_TELEMETRY_EXTENDED (typed, default false) with canary-absence tests. Enabling it is a Railway production env change on the Database service (explicit approval; rollback = set false), gated on a dashboard consumer existing. Do not enable speculatively; do not add unproven fields.
